data.caption:
SBI Clerk Prelims ka intezar khatam, result out ho gaya hai! 📄🔥

📌 SBI ne Clerk Prelims exam ka result declare kar diya hai.
📌 Kul 9,766 pado ke liye yeh bharti ho rahi hai.
📌 Prelims pass karne wale candidates ab Mains exam denge.

Ab sabki nazrein scorecard aur cutoff par tiki hain. 😅

Apne us dost ko tag karo jiska SBI Clerk ka result aane wala tha!
